{{quotation|nightfall|
Three generals report directly to Warmarshal [[Varesh Ossa]]. [[General Morgahn]] has known her the longest, having served under her father for decades. When Varesh was born, Morgahn spent years assisting with her training and the shaping of her character. As a loyal patriot, he considers duty and honor to be the highest virtues a soldier can have. Although Varesh is curious about lofty philosophical concepts like Ascension, Morgahn keeps to a simple faith. He's a devout follower of the goddess [[Lyssa]], holding great respect for artists and crafters. Like any good soldier, he chants his prayers to [[Balthazar]] when charging into battle, but in the dark of night, it's his faith in Lyssa that sustains him.}}

==Armor==
General Morgahn starts with maxed Kournan armor at [[armor rating]] 80. His headgear is a Kournan Regalia. He comes with a [[Suntouched Spear]] (14-25 dmg, 10% dmg when [[health]] is above 50%) and a [[Heraldic Shield]] (armor 16, health +25, requiring 9 [[Command]]).

The appearance of his armor can be upgraded to [[Mysterious armor]] using [[Mysterious Armor Piece]]s acquired from [[the Shadow Nexus]] [[Challenge Mission]]. 

The appearance of his armor can be upgraded to [[Primeval armor]] using [[Primeval Armor Remnants]] acquired in the [[Domain of Anguish]] and during [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]] mission.

See General Morgahn's [[General Morgahn/Armor gallery|armor gallery]].

==Dialogue==
;The Tribunal:
*''Varesh Ossa may be a stern ruler, but it is preposterous to think that she would intentionally hurt Elona.''

;Zehlon Reach:
:''"[[Lyssa]] teaches us that the glory of leadership is found in duty and honor."''

;Tihark Orchard mission:
:''"I am both a soldier and a follower of Lyssa. The two are not in conflict. Both demand devotion and dedication. Without those virtues, a man is worthless."''

;Mirror of Lyss, during quest [[Pledge of the Merchant Princes]]:
:''"The princes were blinded to Varesh's threat by their greed and opulence. I was blinded by loyalty and honor. Lyssa has taught me to look past the illusions in which I encased myself. For the first time in my life I can see clear as day."''

{{spoiler|[[Nightfall]]}}
;Throne of Secrets:
:''"Lyssa must have heard my prayers. Kourna is saved and my dishonor is forgiven. Praise the Six Gods!"''

==Notes==
*He uses the character emotes of a [[warrior]].
*A duplicate Morgahn will show up as a "Kournan Paragon".
*General Morgahn's default weapon is a [[Suntouched Spear]] with 14-25 damage, an attribute requirement of 8 Spear Mastery, Damage +10% while Health is above 50% and it's customized.
*General Morgahn's default shield is a max blue [[Heraldic Shield]] with Health +25 and an attribute requirement of 9 Command.
*As with all heroes, this one has a [[Everlasting Morgahn Tonic|tonic form]].
*Most textures that are meant to decorate his Primeval armor are invisible when viewed from behind, such as the wings on his pauldrons and gloves, and his collar.

==Trivia==
*General Morgahn is a tribute to [[w:Morgan Freeman|Morgan Freeman]]. The General's voice actor in the French version is Benoît Allemane, the official French voice of Morgan Freeman.
*Morgahn's appearence and vocal performance is very similar to that of [[w:Samuel E. Wright|Samuel E. Wright]]
*His quote, "Put your faith in the gods, but keep your weapons out," is a reference to Oliver Cromwell's quote [http://www.phrases.org.uk/meanings/217500.html found here]: "... trust in God, and keep your powder dry," since gunpowder needed to be completely dry to be used at all.
